_comment: Known unresolvable internal links, frozen 18/08/2026. The guard in internal-links.test.ts fails on anything NEW. Fix a link, then delete its entry here - the test also fails if a listed entry no longer reproduces, so the baseline cannot rot.
_falsePositiveNote: Entries marked known-safe are not defects. The scanner reads href= in source, not what renders, so a component that accepts an href prop and deliberately renders no link shows up here. Do not change those routes.

/dashboard/seo/hreflang.reason: known-safe: SEOToolCard receives this href but the comingSoon branch (app/dashboard/seo/page.tsx:91) renders a div with a toast, never a Link. No 404 is reachable.

/dashboard/seo/content.reason: known-safe: same comingSoon branch as above. No 404 is reachable.

/reference-library.reason: REAL defect, needs a founder decision. This is the Real Images Only blocked state telling the user to 'Add real photos to the reference library', and the destination does not exist. There is no reference-library UI at all: the manifest is public/reference-library/manifest.json and private refs are ingested via POST /api/admin/private-refs. Pointing it at /dashboard/media would be wrong, since that browses media_assets rather than owned references.

/docs/getting-started.reason: REAL defect. app/docs/ contains only page.tsx, no subdirectories. Needs a founder decision on whether docs pages get written or the cards point elsewhere.

/docs/api-reference.reason: REAL defect, but has an obvious destination: the public /api-reference route already exists.

/docs/advanced-features.reason: REAL defect. Nearest existing route is /features.

/docs/team-collaboration.reason: REAL defect. No existing route covers this.

/docs/security.reason: REAL defect, but has an obvious destination: the public /security route already exists.
